title: How Sweet Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: **SNOWBIRD PROMOTION- Save 50% PER NIGHT January and February for monthly stays!** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Directly behind the Seaside town square! Can't beat this Location! - One house away from the Seaside private beach access at West Ruskin - You will have 2 RFID access card for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - KING bed - 2 adult sized beach cruisers - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals - Charcoal grill - Fully stocked kitchen - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $28/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($50 fee applies at booking). Located 2 houses up from 30A and seconds to the beach in SEASIDE, FL "How Sweet" is the perfect guest cottage oasis with everything from a KING master suite to a full kitchen and even a washer/dryer! How Sweet it is to stay here! Guest cottage to "Amazing Grace", "How Sweet" can be rented together or separate. This one-bedroom cottage offers a beautiful king master suite on the main level complete with marble en-suite (shower only), and barn door for privacy. A spiral staircase takes you upstairs to a gorgeous stainless FULL kitchen complete with fridge, stove-top, oven, dishwasher, and microwave. Eat-in dining space for 2, an open living room, flat screen TV and half bath complete the upstairs. ACCOMMODATIONS: (sleeps 2) Main floor: Bedroom 1: King bed, ensuite bathroom Up the spiral staircase Living area : TV, Kitchen and 1/2 bath IMPORTANT DETAILS ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $28/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market.
